description: Rokid Glasses AIUI Agent - last glance: leaving a hotel room, a seat or a campsite, you worry whether anything was left behind or a window left open, and once you have walked away you want to turn back and check. This agent archives one last look, zone by zone, as you turn around once before leaving: six heading zones (front / front-right / rear-right / rear / rear-left / front-left), each photographed (wide field) and described in one short line by the host model, confirmed by you, and only then counted. A zone you never photographed stays visibly missing, and only 6/6 lights the 'you may leave' summary. Later, on the road, when the worry returns, you replay zone by zone: each zone shows its short description plus a 'photo archived' marker - the display is monochrome green and cannot replay colour photos, so the description is the replay and the photo is the session archive, never a photo playback. Nothing is ever stored: the archive lives in session memory only and dies when the agent closes. There is no indoor positioning and no room map: zones come only from the order you turned through them.
name: last-glance
